title: VASPRO country pack
description: The versioned, per-country rules platform/packs loads (ROADMAP Stage A item A6; D-09). Required fields are what task 0.10 needs now (numbering, currency, tax, send windows); operators/routes/rails/compliance_keywords/test_numbers are reserved here so later tasks (Phase 7 routes, Stage A6 completion) only need to add data, not change this schema.

version.description: Pack version, pinned by callers via packs.LoadPinned.

timezone.description: IANA time zone a new account in this country starts with, e.g. Africa/Nairobi (accounts.tenants.timezone).

data_region.description: Data residency tag a new account in this country starts with (accounts.tenants.region). Hosting is still OD-02; task 2.10 builds the residency rules.

kyb.description: Business verification in this country (task 2.7): which company registry a business profile is checked against, and what the tax ID is called. A country without it can't do KYB yet.

services.description: Each service's minimum KYC tier and availability in this country (task 2.4, OQ-06), keyed by accounts' service code. accounts syncs it into service_country_rules; a service not listed uses the catalogue default and is enabled.

country_code.description: E.164 calling code, no leading +, e.g. 254.

operators.description: Reserved for Stage A6 completion; not required by task 0.10.

routes.description: Reserved for Phase 7 (A6: "routes needed by Phase 7").

rails.description: Reserved for Stage A6 completion / Phase 4+.

test_numbers.description: Reserved for Stage A6 completion (ROADMAP §8.4's reserved test number blocks).
